card.name: Words just before "effects" of a drug
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected "effects" or "actions", such as the end of pharmacologic, or a small word after enhance or potentiate. Found in overdosage and drug interaction text.

modes.label: Pharmacologic before effects
modes.description: The middle or end of pharmacologic or a similar adjective, just before "effects" in overdose text.
modes.example: may result in exaggeration of the pharmac<<ologic>> effects such as increased Hb.

modes.label: Small word after enhance or potentiate
modes.description: A word like "the" or "their" after a verb meaning to boost, before an effect noun.
modes.example: imipramine hydrochloride may enhance<< the>> CNS depressant effects of alcohol

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "actions" or "action" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "effects" or "actions" of a drug, as in overdose or interaction warnings.
